title: Live Sync Crashing attempting to Connect UE5.5
content:
Hey guys so I followed all the steps outlined in that guide for CLO Live Sync guide using the correct versions. I'm using UE5.5, I tried multiple different versions of Clo with its corresponding plugin version installed in UE5.5, downgrading my Clo3D from the latest to 2024.1.88. I have enabled directx 11 with transparency as well as the Adobe substance Plugin in UE5.5. I'm not in simulation mode or anything. However, after opening the window in Unreal, after I click the button to link Clo and Unreal the engine crashes. The closest I got was enabling unified material before clicking the button. The plugin gets stuck on 20% then still crashes. I was wondering if anyone knows an advisable fix for this? Not sure if its an Unreal or Clo problem, I just attached my crash log. Any help would be much appreciated. Thanks.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/1883d027e3494fef8f4f74a8f0f37922/images/5ec1d4e9a90949ab8f164195cd8464c6Screenshot%202025-02-07%20104645.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hello dacrequin, we have just released LiveSync 1.1.6, which includes a bug fix for this crash issue. Please download the latest version from our version archive and let us know if the issue has been resolved: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/1883d027e3494fef8f4f74a8f0f37922

Comment 2: Hi dacrequin, sorry to hear that LiveSync keeps crashing. I would like to learn more about the issue you have experienced. Unfortunately it is difficult to tell the cause of the issue, so could you submit a Zendesk support ticket with the following information and a crash log file? 1. CLO version, 2. CLO LiveSync version, 3. a crash log file which can be found in your Unreal project file > Saved > Logs folder, 4. the source ZPRJ file (if possible), 5. a link to this post. Thanks!
content_description: A community forum page for troubleshooting crashes and linking issues between Clo3D and Unreal Engine 5.5 during Live Sync integration.

title: DXF and RUL export errors when import to Gemini CAD
content:
**1\. Pattern designed and graded in Clo3d  
2\. Exported as DXF/AAMA With RUL file using Clo3d  
3\. Imported as DXF/AAMA to Gemini CAD  
4\. Base size is correct but grading size are not**

**i try to import the same DXF to new project in Clo3d, works perfectly fine**

**My size in Clo3d (the correct one):**

**size 1: 57,55 x 66,15  
size 2: 65,56 x 70,15  
size 3: 68,37 x 71.5**

**Gemini CAD size from my computer :**

**Size 1: 57,55 x 66,15  
Size 2: 54,93 x 70,15  
Size 3: 52,09 x 74,15**

**Gemini CAD size from the cutter:**

**Size 1: 57,55 x 61,08  
Size 2: 54,57 x 65,08  
Size 3: 51,80 x 69,08**

**What is causing the problem? Can someone try open import the dxf to another CAD program?**

<https://we.tl/t-hn7WPUbPaE>

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/6181dfd7af50486b86c9c9c0a734b877/images/759ab11711744789b80fc37e21ee01a3Screenshot%202025-02-05%20at%2013.52.24.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/6181dfd7af50486b86c9c9c0a734b877/images/bed9027f0ea841eea35f29f1b058974cScreenshot%202025-02-05%20at%2013.56.53.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/6181dfd7af50486b86c9c9c0a734b877/images/b3a9c621cf8c4e36a6eed73bb4be47d5Screenshot%202025-02-05%20at%2013.57.41.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There. It looks like you have already sent in t ticket to our tech support. This is great as they will be best equipped to answer you. But it looks like the account you sent it through does not have a CLO license attached. Please add to your ticket what your CLO ID or email attached to your paid license is. Thank you
